blocks.text: 🪝 Static GK: ASEAN Membership Evolution & Original 5 Founding Members. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Established via Bangkok Declaration on August 8, 1967 (India non-member).
Founding Members (Original 5): Indonesia, Malaysia, Philippines, Singapore, and Thailand.
Expanded Members (6 Later Nations): Brunei (1984), Vietnam (1995), Laos & Myanmar (1997), Cambodia (1999), and Timor-Leste (2025).
India membership status (Non-member) vs Timor-Leste accession (11th member, 2025).
